content.value: A line with direction cosines proportional to (2, 7, -5) is drawn to intersect the lines $\textstyle { \frac { x - 5 } { 3 } } = { \frac { y - 7 } { - 1 } } = { \frac { z + 2 } { 1 } } { \mathrm { ~ a n d ~ } } { \frac { x + 3 } { - 3 } } = { \frac { y - 3 } { 2 } } = { \frac { z - 6 } { 4 } }$ . Find the co-ordinates of the point of intersection and the length.intercepted on it.
